title: 751. Shortest Completing Word

examples.explanation: Shortest word covering s, p, s, t.
Only s is needed; pest is earliest among length-4 fits.
Needs a, b, c twice; cbca is shortest.

hints: Count plate letters case-insensitively and ignore everything that is not a letter.
A word qualifies when each of its 26 letter counts meets or beats the plate counts.
Track the best word seen so far, replacing it only on a strictly shorter qualifier to keep the earliest tie.
